solutions.title: Seen set
solutions.strategy: Track values already observed and return the first value observed twice.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each array element is checked once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The set can store every distinct value before the duplicate is found.

solutions.title: Value binary search
solutions.strategy: Binary-search the value range using counts to decide which half must contain a duplicate.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each value-range step counts across the full array.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only range boundaries and counters are stored.

solutions.title: Floyd cycle detection
solutions.strategy: Treat each value as a next pointer and find the entrance of the induced cycle.

timeComplexity.explanation: The tortoise and hare pointers traverse a linear number of links.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only two pointer values are stored.
